result.title: LightSEAD: Lightweight SE(3)-Aware Keypoint Detector through Selective Knowledge Distillation
result.summary: The pursuit of improved performance in deep learning has often been accompanied by increasing architectural complexity and computational demands. We explore an alternative direction: achieving more with less through structured supervision. We introduce LightSEAD, a lightweight SE(3)-aware keypoint detector initialised with calibrated Harris pseudo-labels and enriched through viewpoint-aware and appearance-aware supervision and selective knowledge distillation. LightSEAD comprises only six convolutional layers and 84,289 learnable parameters, achieving competitive repeatability across HPatches, KITTI 06 and 4Seasons while demonstrating its downstream applicability to relative pose estimation on MegaDepth-1500. Further optimised for mixed-precision inference, LightSEAD Coarse achieves approximately 909 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 and 139 FPS on a Jetson Orin Nano Super.

AI.brief_summary: 提出仅六层卷积、约8.4万参数的轻量 SE(3) 感知关键点检测器 LightSEAD，用校准的 Harris 伪标签、视角与外观感知监督及选择性知识蒸馏训练，并优化混合精度推理速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理主线无直接关系，但其「用伪标签加选择性蒸馏向小模型注入视角/几何感知监督」的思路，可能为 LVR 中如何把几何与任务必要信息压入紧凑内部状态提供可核查的训练侧线索。
